concerns.text: US-2 scenario 1 says 'stops early if validation loss does not improve for a defined patience period' while FR-004 fixes 'early stopping (patience=10)'. Use the concrete value (or reference FR-004) in the user story so the two statements cannot drift apart.

FR-009 mandates stratified k-fold cross-validation (SC-006 and Assumptions pin 5 folds), while US-2 scenario 3 and the Independent Test describe a single held-out test set with train/test separation. The spec never states how the held-out test set relates to the CV folds (nested? disjoint?). Reconcile so the evaluation protocol is a single coherent procedure.

Terminology drifts between 'gas-MOF pairs' (US-1, FR-001, Assumptions) and 'molecule-framework pairs' (US-1 story text, Key Entities 'Gas-MOF Pair' defined as permeant molecule + porous framework). Since IZA zeolites are also frameworks, pick one term (e.g. 'gas-framework pair') and use it consistently.
